title: Semantius translation work file
description: What one language still needs, in one file, for a translator (usually an agent) to fill in. Written by apps/web/scripts/i18n/translate.mjs into apps/web/.i18n/ (git-ignored) and read back by import.mjs. Every entry carries its English source and where the app met it, so a translation can be made in context; `translation` is the only field to edit.

locale.description: The catalog language being translated, e.g. de-DE.

generated.description: When the file was produced. Informational.

entries.description: The work, grouped by scope. A scope with nothing outstanding is absent.

key.description: For `message`, the English source text itself — there are no message ids. For a label scope, `<table>.<field>.<attribute>` or `<slug>.<attribute>`. For `server` / `rule`, the message the backend produced, verbatim.

context.description: Disambiguates two identical English strings with different meanings ('View' the noun vs the verb). Empty when there is none.

source.description: The English (or, for a runtime message, the original) text to translate.

translation.description: FILL THIS IN. Empty means still untranslated; import.mjs skips it.

comment.description: A note the developer left for the translator.

placeholders.description: The ICU placeholders the source uses. The translation MUST use exactly these — import.mjs refuses the file otherwise, because a dropped placeholder loses data on screen and an invented one renders as literal braces.

origin.description: Where it comes from: source files for a code string, the route or rule the app met a runtime message on.
